concept.hr: Portovi koje studenti susreću, složeni po uslugama, i tri raspona IANA-e
concept.en: The ports students meet, grouped by service, and IANA's three ranges

summary.hr: Plakat: tri raspona na traci i 28 kartica po uslugama; filtriraj po TCP/UDP-u, usluzi, rasponu i kolegiju, klikni karticu za njezin siguran par.
summary.en: A poster: three ranges on a bar and 28 cards by service; filter by TCP/UDP, service, range and course, click a card for its secure pair.
